gbm_population_evidence.quote: RMC-5552 Monotherapy in Adult Subjects With Recurrent Glioblastoma
Participants must have histologically or cytologically confirmed 1st, 2nd or 3rd recurrence GBM that has recurred or progressed (per standard RANO criteria) after standard treatment regimen

candidate_evidence.quote: RMC-5552 is a type of medicine called an mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibitor.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: RMC-5552 Monotherapy in Adult Subjects With Recurrent Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Median drug levels of RMC-5552 in tumor tissue of participants in Cohort B will be measured at time of tumor issue removal/surgical resection.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess pharmacodynamic (PD) markers of drug activity, including biochemical markers of mTORC1 pathway inhibition in tumor tissue. (Cohort B).

role_evidence.quote: RMC-5552 Monotherapy in Adult Subjects With Recurrent Glioblastoma

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: This protein controls cancer cell growth, and the study doctors believe stopping mTOR from forming may help to kill tumor cells.
arms: Cohort A 1(Dose Escalation, Recurrent Non-surgical GBM)
Cohort A2 (Dose Escalation, Recurrent Non-surgical GBM)
Cohort B (Dose Expansion, Recurrent Surgical GBM)
Cohort C (Dose Expansion, Recurrent Non-surgical GBM)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: mTORC1 pathway phospho-markers in tumour tissue (pS6RP, p4EBP1, pAKT/total AKT, p-PRAS40/total PRAS40)

source_quote.quote: To assess pharmacodynamic (PD) markers of drug activity, including biochemical markers of mTORC1 pathway inhibition in fresh tumor tissue and in archival tissue, levels of pS6RP will be measured.

arms: Cohort B (Dose Expansion, Recurrent Surgical GBM)

coder_notes: Non-randomised multi-cohort single-agent study; all arms experimental with RMC-5552, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no. Tumour PK and pharmacodynamic tissue markers planned only in Cohort B (surgical), which per the description closed before enrolment. cns5_terminology coded historical because the detailed description uses 'glioblastoma multiforme'; no IDH requirement. Additional Cohort B tissue markers (cleaved caspase 3, MIB-1) are proliferation/apoptosis readouts, not recorded as separate molecular biomarkers. No eligibility or enrichment biomarker.
